easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vizier of Many Faces.
description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Vizier of Many Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Vizier of Many Faces. Choose to have Vizier of Many Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
